---
name: Platform adapter
about: Ask for, or offer, support for a lecture platform
labels: adapter
---

An adapter follows `skills/tutor-any-lecture/references/adapters/TEMPLATE.md`. Answer what you can under each of its headings below. Write no real institution's address: use placeholders such as `<platform_url>`, `<course>` and `<id>`. Do you want to write the adapter yourself, or are you asking for one?

## Platform

Which platform is it, who uses it, and what does it hold for a lecture (a recording, captions, a transcript export, slides)?

## URL patterns

What do the page addresses look like, with every institution-specific part replaced by a placeholder?

## Where transcripts/captions live

Where on the page, or in which export, is the timed text, and in which format (SRT, VTT, JSON, timestamped TXT, other)?

## Read-only steps

Which steps get to the transcript and slides without changing anything on the platform?

## Downloads offered?

Which downloads does the platform itself offer, and to whom?

## Known pitfalls

What goes wrong: delays before material appears, misleading labels, empty transcripts, sign-in or bot checks?

## Verified by (name/date) or "experimental"

Have you followed these steps on a real lecture? If so, when (no personal names)?
